title: Crypto misuse: SHA sess_reset leaves inited=true with uninitialized hash struct on re-init failure
description: wolfssl_sha_sess_reset() calls wc_Sha*Free() then wc_InitSha*(). If re-init fails, ctx->inited stays true. Subsequent sess_free() calls wc_Sha*Free() on an already-freed struct: double-free. Same structural defect as WOLFKM-ms3.9 (HMAC) and WOLFKM-ms3.10 (CMAC). Fix: clear ctx->inited before the re-init attempt, or on re-init failure.
